text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, such as individual functions, while integration tests make sure that different parts of the system work together correctly. Many developers also use test-driven development, which means they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think clearly about what the code should do. Good testing gives developers confidence. When they know their tests are strong, they can change the code without fear of breaking things. In the end, testing saves time and helps teams build more reliable software.
